payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort the ratings and check if the n-th smallest is strictly less than the (n+1)-th smallest, ensuring the best of the first n is weaker than the worst of the last n.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts to separate the weaker half from the stronger half; if the max of the weaker half is less than the min of the stronger half, then any pairing results in first team always losing, so the condition checks a gap after sorting.
